title: Senior Cybersecurity Engineer
description_html:
KalSoft is seeking a seasoned Senior Cybersecurity Engineer to enhance our security team. This role is tailored for professionals with deep expertise in Cybersecurity, Cloud Security, OT/IoT Security, Security Architecture, and Risk Management. The successful candidate will play a critical role in deploying enterprise-wide security solutions, managing risks, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards, and bolstering the organization's overall cyber resilience.

Key Responsibilities

- Design and deploy cybersecurity solutions across enterprise, cloud, and OT/IoT environments to safeguard critical assets.
- Conduct comprehensive risk assessments, penetration testing, and vulnerability management to identify and mitigate security threats.
- Develop secure architectures by applying secure-by-design principles to all systems and applications.
- Lead threat detection efforts, manage incident response protocols, and enhance ransomware resilience strategies.
- Protect cloud workloads, critical infrastructure, and sensitive enterprise data from emerging cyber threats.
- Implement and maintain security controls aligned with industry standards and compliance frameworks.
- Collaborate closely with engineering, IT, and business units to integrate security best practices across the organization.
- Support governance initiatives, data privacy efforts, and continuous improvement of security posture.

Required Qualifications

- Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in Cybersecurity or Information Security roles.
- Proven expertise in Cybersecurity, Cloud Security, and OT/IoT Security domains.
- Hands-on experience with penetration testing, risk assessment, and vulnerability management techniques.
- Strong knowledge of incident response processes, ransomware mitigation, and data privacy regulations.
- Familiarity with secure engineering methodologies and secure-by-design principles.
- In-depth understanding of security frameworks and standards including NIST, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, AI RMF, HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, FISMA, FedRAMP, OWASP, and ISA/IEC 62443.
- Experience securing enterprise systems, cloud environments, and critical infrastructure components.
- Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
- Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits

- Professional certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CEH, OSCP, or equivalents are highly desirable.
- Experience with Generative AI security and AI risk management frameworks.
- Exposure to regulated industries such as healthcare, government, energy, oil and gas, or manufacturing.
- Strong background in security architecture, governance, and compliance management.
- Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives and work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.

This position offers the opportunity to work in a dynamic environment where cybersecurity expertise directly contributes to protecting critical assets and advancing organizational resilience. Candidates passionate about driving security innovation and compliance within complex environments are encouraged to apply.

title: Cyber Security Analyst L4
description_html:
Wipro Limited is a global leader in technology services and consulting, dedicated to delivering innovative solutions that address complex digital transformation challenges. With a comprehensive portfolio spanning consulting, design, engineering, and operations, Wipro empowers clients to achieve their boldest ambitions and build sustainable, future-ready businesses. Operating across 65 countries with over 230,000 employees and partners, Wipro is committed to helping customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever-evolving world.

The role focuses on analyzing cyber attack patterns, developing incident response strategies, ensuring audit readiness, and implementing disaster recovery plans. The objective is to maintain strict adherence to cybersecurity regulatory frameworks while minimizing business disruption and enhancing overall security posture.

Key Responsibilities

Monitoring and Incident Detection: Analyze attack trends and correlate logs across multiple systems to identify advanced threats. Continuously improve monitoring processes to enable faster threat detection and ensure compliance with relevant security frameworks and regulatory standards.

Incident Handling and Analysis: Conduct root cause analysis for security incidents, develop comprehensive incident response plans, and implement disaster recovery measures aimed at minimizing operational impact.

Threat Assessment and Analytics: Perform forensic investigations using advanced analytics tools. Develop and apply mitigation strategies that align with compliance requirements and strengthen the organization’s security defenses.

Stakeholder Coordination and Audit Assistance: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, external vendors, and auditors to maintain compliance with security frameworks. Maintain accurate audit documentation and implement processes that support audit readiness and continuous regulatory compliance.

Training and Awareness: Support the creation and delivery of cybersecurity awareness programs, including guidance on recognizing and responding to phishing attempts and malicious emails.

Required Qualifications

- Proven experience of 5 to 8 years in cybersecurity roles, with a strong focus on incident detection, response, and recovery.
- Expertise in Azure Cloud Workload Security, including securing cloud environments and workloads.
- Solid understanding of cybersecurity regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements.
- Skilled in forensic analysis and threat assessment using advanced analytics tools.
- Ability to coordinate effectively with multiple stakeholders, including internal teams, vendors, and auditors.
- Experience in developing and delivering cybersecurity training and awareness sessions.

Wipro is committed to fostering a culture of reinvention and continuous learning. As a digital transformation partner with bold ambitions, the company encourages professionals who are inspired to evolve their careers and skills in alignment with the rapidly changing technology landscape. Joining Wipro means becoming part of a purpose-driven organization that empowers individuals to shape their own growth and contribute meaningfully to the future of the industry.

title: Cyber Security Business Analyst
description_html:
We are seeking a skilled Cyber Security Business Analyst to enhance vulnerability management, security governance reporting, data quality, and tooling assessments within a global enterprise setting. This role involves consolidating security data from multiple sources, improving the accuracy of reports, coordinating initiatives to enhance ServiceNow CMDB data quality, reviewing vulnerability risk acceptances, and leading market evaluations for vulnerability scanning and aggregation platforms. The successful candidate will have strong analytical and reporting capabilities, business analysis expertise, and excellent stakeholder management skills, alongside a solid understanding of cybersecurity risk and regulatory governance frameworks.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the preparation and delivery of weekly security posture reports, monthly Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), and governance reports for various committees including the Technology Risk Committee (TRC), Information Security Committee (ISC), OpsCom, and Lloyd’s oversight. Consolidate and reconcile data from vulnerability scanning tools, security testing, cloud platforms, and ServiceNow to create a consistent and reliable source of security reporting.

Develop and maintain dashboards using Power BI or equivalent tools, including trend analysis, reporting metrics, and automated reporting processes tailored for senior stakeholders. Validate the accuracy of reports, investigate any data discrepancies, document necessary restatements, and track governance actions to completion.

Collaborate closely with ServiceNow CMDB and IT asset management teams to improve asset ownership, business criticality tagging, CIF tagging, service relationships, and overall security data quality. Reconcile asset inventories across scanning, endpoint detection, cloud, and security testing platforms to identify missing, duplicate, stale, or unscanned assets.

Lead market assessments for vulnerability scanning and aggregation platforms by gathering requirements, evaluating vendors, conducting demonstrations and proofs of concept, performing cost comparisons, and assessing integration capabilities. Prepare business cases, recommendation papers, and transition plans for vulnerability management tooling, considering infrastructure, cloud, containers, application security, and integration with ServiceNow/Jira.

Review vulnerability risk acceptances, exceptions, and waivers to validate justifications, compensating controls, ownership, and expiry dates. Flag outdated or high-risk acceptances for reassessment. Conduct business analysis activities including process mapping, requirements gathering, and stakeholder workshops to identify gaps and recommend improvements in vulnerability management and security governance processes.

Support regulatory, audit, and compliance reporting requirements, including DORA, Lloyd’s Principle 12, remediation Metric 7, and PRA engagements. Work collaboratively with Cyber Defence, IT, Risk, Compliance, Procurement, and security tooling vendors to enhance reporting, operational efficiency, and governance processes.

Required Qualifications

Proven experience in business analysis within cybersecurity, IT risk, information security, or a related enterprise environment. Strong data analysis and reporting skills, including advanced proficiency in Excel and Power BI or equivalent dashboarding tools.

Working knowledge of ServiceNow CMDB, IT asset management, configuration data, and the impact of data quality on security operations. Understanding of vulnerability management concepts, risk-based prioritization, and security scoring methodologies such as CVSS, EPSS, and CISA KEV.

Experience conducting technology market assessments, vendor evaluations, requirements gathering, weighted scoring, business case development, and facilitating stakeholder workshops. Familiarity with risk acceptance, exception management, and governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) processes.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical security risks and data insights into clear, business-focused, and committee-level reporting.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits

Experience in financial services or insurance sectors is advantageous. Familiarity with vulnerability management tools such as Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7, Vulcan, or Microsoft Defender for Cloud is preferred. Knowledge of regulatory reporting frameworks including DORA, Lloyd’s, and PRA is beneficial.

Experience with CMDB improvement initiatives and reporting automation using Power Query or Python is a plus. Relevant certifications such as CBAP, BCS Business Analysis, ITIL, Security+, or CRISC are highly regarded.

This role offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of cybersecurity, risk management, and business analysis within a dynamic global environment, contributing to the continuous improvement of security governance and vulnerability management practices.

title: Cyber Defence SecOps Analyst
description_html:
We are seeking a skilled Cyber Defence SecOps Analyst to join our global security team. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in security operations, vulnerability management, incident response, and threat hunting within an enterprise environment. This role involves supporting vulnerability assessment and remediation, investigating security incidents, managing asset and scan coverage, and maintaining security tooling. The candidate must be adaptable to support multiple workstreams and participate in a shared 24/7 on-call rotation.

Key Responsibilities

- Analyze and prioritize vulnerabilities from various sources, including Tenable, Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike Falcon, Darktrace, GitHub Advanced Security, and application security testing tools.
- Track vulnerabilities from identification through closure, coordinating remediation efforts with infrastructure, cloud, application, and platform teams, and validating remediation evidence.
- Prioritize exposures based on exploitability, CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, threat intelligence, asset criticality, and attack paths.
- Investigate security alerts and suspicious activities across endpoint, network, identity, and cloud environments, supporting incident triage, containment, and escalation processes.
- Conduct threat hunting using endpoint detection, network monitoring, cloud security, and SIEM data, including investigations into emerging AI-enabled threats.
- Support application security activities such as SAST, DAST, SCA, code review findings, and security testing within CI/CD pipelines.
- Reconcile asset and scan data across security tools and ServiceNow CMDB, identify coverage gaps, and support continuous external attack surface monitoring.
- Troubleshoot security tool integrations, support vulnerability aggregation platforms like Vulcan, and contribute to automation, scripting, dashboards, and reporting.
- Participate in security testing, purple-team exercises, tool evaluations, and AI-assisted security initiatives.
- Maintain accurate incident records, handover documentation, remediation trackers, and reporting inputs to support security governance.
- Participate in a shared 24/7 on-call rota, respond to escalations within agreed timelines, and coordinate with SOC/MXDR providers and internal security teams.

Required Qualifications

- 3 to 5 years of experience in security operations, vulnerability management, or cybersecurity engineering within an enterprise setting.
- Hands-on experience with vulnerability management and security tools such as Tenable, CrowdStrike Falcon, Darktrace, Microsoft Defender, and GitHub Advanced Security; familiarity with Vulcan or similar platforms is preferred.
- Strong understanding of vulnerability assessment and risk-based prioritization, including CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, threat intelligence, and remediation tracking.
- Experience in incident response, security alert triage, and threat hunting across endpoint, network, identity, and cloud environments.
- Working knowledge of Windows, Linux, Azure, networking, enterprise infrastructure, SSDLC, CI/CD, and application security testing methodologies (SAST, DAST, SCA).
- Experience with ServiceNow or Jira for ticket management, data querying using KQL or SQL, and reporting tools such as Excel or Power BI.
- Awareness of emerging cybersecurity threats, including AI-assisted vulnerability discovery, AI-enabled ransomware, and agentic AI abuse.
- Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and stakeholder coordination skills, with the ability to adapt to changing priorities and participate in an on-call rotation.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits

- Experience in financial services or insurance sectors.
- Skills in penetration testing, red/purple teaming, and AI security testing.
- Knowledge of CMDB and asset management.
- Scripting experience using Python or PowerShell.
- Relevant certifications such as Security+, CySA+, GCIH, OSCP, or vendor-specific security certifications.

This role offers the opportunity to work in a dynamic, global enterprise environment, contributing to advanced security operations and innovative AI-assisted initiatives.

title: Cyber Security Business Analyst
description_html:
We are seeking a skilled Cyber Security Business Analyst to enhance vulnerability management, security governance reporting, data quality, and tooling assessments within a global enterprise setting. This role involves consolidating security data, improving the accuracy of reports, coordinating ServiceNow CMDB data quality initiatives, reviewing vulnerability risk acceptances, and leading market assessments for vulnerability scanning and aggregation platforms. The successful candidate will demonstrate strong analytical and reporting capabilities, business analysis expertise, and effective stakeholder management, alongside a solid understanding of cybersecurity risk and regulatory governance.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the preparation of weekly security posture reports, monthly Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), and governance reports for various committees including the Technology Risk Committee, Information Security Committee, OpsCom, and Lloyd’s oversight. Consolidate and reconcile data from multiple sources such as vulnerability scanning tools, security testing, cloud platforms, and ServiceNow to create a consistent and reliable security reporting framework.

Develop and maintain dashboards using Power BI or equivalent tools, perform trend analysis, define reporting metrics, and automate reporting processes for senior stakeholders. Validate the accuracy of reports, investigate discrepancies, document any restatements, and track governance actions through to resolution.

Collaborate closely with ServiceNow CMDB and IT asset management teams to enhance asset ownership, business criticality, CIF tagging, service relationships, and overall security data quality. Reconcile asset inventories across scanning, endpoint detection, cloud, and security testing platforms to identify missing, duplicate, stale, or unscanned assets.

Lead market assessments for vulnerability scanning and aggregation platforms by gathering requirements, evaluating vendors, coordinating demonstrations and proofs of concept, conducting cost comparisons, and assessing integration capabilities. Prepare business cases, recommendation papers, and transition plans for vulnerability management tooling, considering infrastructure, cloud, containers, application security, and integration with platforms such as ServiceNow and Jira.

Review vulnerability risk acceptances, exceptions, and waivers to validate justifications, compensating controls, ownership, and expiry dates. Flag any outdated or high-risk acceptances for reassessment. Conduct business analysis activities including process mapping, requirements gathering, and stakeholder workshops to identify gaps and recommend improvements in vulnerability management and security governance.

Support regulatory, audit, and compliance reporting requirements related to frameworks such as DORA, Lloyd’s Principle 12, remediation Metric 7, and PRA engagements. Work collaboratively with Cyber Defence, IT, Risk, Compliance, Procurement, and security tooling vendors to enhance reporting, operational efficiency, and governance processes.

Required Qualifications

Proven experience in business analysis within cybersecurity, IT risk, information security, or a related enterprise environment. Strong data analysis and reporting skills, including advanced proficiency in Excel and Power BI or similar dashboarding tools.

Working knowledge of ServiceNow CMDB, IT asset management, configuration data, and the impact of data quality on security operations. Solid understanding of vulnerability management concepts, risk-based prioritization, and security scoring methodologies such as CVSS, EPSS, and CISA KEV.

Experience conducting technology market assessments, vendor evaluations, requirements gathering, weighted scoring, business case development, and facilitating stakeholder workshops. Familiarity with risk acceptance, exception management, and governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) processes.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, capable of translating technical security risks and data insights into clear, business-oriented, and committee-level reporting.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits

Experience in financial services or insurance sectors is advantageous. Familiarity with vulnerability management tools such as Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7, Vulcan, or Microsoft Defender for Cloud is preferred. Knowledge of regulatory reporting requirements including DORA, Lloyd’s, and PRA is beneficial.

Experience with CMDB improvement initiatives and reporting automation using Power Query or Python is desirable. Relevant certifications such as CBAP, BCS Business Analysis, ITIL, Security+, or CRISC will be considered a strong asset.

title: Cyber Defence Manager
description_html:
We are seeking a seasoned Cyber Defence Manager to lead vulnerability management, security findings consolidation, cyber incident coordination, and post-incident governance within a global enterprise environment. This role emphasizes risk-based prioritization of security exposures, tracking remediation efforts, managing incident response, ensuring regulatory compliance, and driving security initiatives to completion. The successful candidate will collaborate closely with Cyber Defence, Security Operations, Infrastructure, Application, Risk, and business teams to enhance the organization’s overall security posture.

Key Responsibilities

- Own and consolidate security findings from various sources including vulnerability scans, penetration tests, red/purple team exercises, cloud security assessments, application security testing, and threat intelligence.

- Prioritize vulnerabilities using risk-based methodologies such as CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, threat intelligence, asset criticality, and Critically Important Function (CIF) status.

- Coordinate remediation activities with infrastructure, patch management, application, and service owners, ensuring compliance with SLAs and reducing aged vulnerabilities.

- Monitor remediation progress, mean time to remediate (MTTR), security posture metrics, scan coverage, and SLA breaches; escalate critical exposures and delays to appropriate stakeholders.

- Manage vulnerability exceptions and risk acceptance workflows, ensuring documented ownership, compensating controls, approvals, and expiry dates.

- Prepare security posture reports, Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), and governance updates for committees and senior leadership.

- Lead coordination of cyber incidents from initiation through closure, including incident response meetings, stakeholder communications, documentation, and escalation.

- Conduct post-incident reviews, root cause analysis, and lessons-learned sessions, ensuring corrective actions are tracked to completion.

- Maintain central incident records, post-event trackers, and manage on-call and notification arrangements, including out-of-hours coverage.

- Support regulatory and compliance requirements such as DORA, Lloyd’s Principle 12, remediation Metric 7, and PRA engagements.

- Collaborate with security engineering, architecture, and tooling teams to enhance vulnerability management processes, reporting automation, scan coverage, and data quality.

- Oversee scanning attestations and pre-change governance to ensure systems are scanned appropriately before deployment.

- Provide guidance to SecOps analysts and coordinate cross-functional remediation and incident management activities.

Required Qualifications

- Proven experience in vulnerability management, security operations, or cyber defence within large, complex, and preferably regulated enterprise environments.

- Hands-on experience with vulnerability management platforms such as Tenable, Qualys, Vulcan, or equivalents.

- Working knowledge of cloud security, particularly Microsoft Defender for Cloud/Azure, container security, and application security testing tools including SAST, DAST, and SCA.

- Strong understanding of vulnerability risk assessment and prioritization methodologies including CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, threat intelligence, and asset criticality.

- Demonstrated ability to manage remediation SLAs, reduce vulnerability backlogs, coordinate incident response, conduct root cause analysis, and track corrective actions.

- Knowledge of security governance, risk acceptance, exception management, KRIs, and regulatory reporting requirements including DORA, Lloyd’s, and PRA.

- Experience with ServiceNow workflows, incident management platforms, and remediation tracking processes.

- Excellent stakeholder management, communication, analytical, and organizational skills with the ability to engage both technical teams and senior management effectively.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits

- Experience in financial services or insurance sectors.

- Familiarity with red/purple teaming and threat-led penetration testing.

- Experience with on-call tools such as PagerDuty or xMatters.

- Knowledge of CMDB and asset management, automation, AI-assisted reporting.

- Relevant certifications such as CISSP, GIAC, or ITIL are highly desirable.

This role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on the security posture of a global enterprise by leading critical cyber defence initiatives and working alongside diverse teams to mitigate risks and respond effectively to cyber threats.

- Strong understanding of vulnerability assessment and risk-based prioritization frameworks including CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, threat intelligence, and remediation tracking.

- Experience in financial services or insurance sectors.
- Background in penetration testing, red or purple teaming, and AI security testing.
- Familiarity with CMDB and asset management processes.
- Scripting skills using Python or PowerShell.
- Relevant certifications such as Security+, CySA+, GCIH, OSCP, or vendor-specific security credentials.

Candidates who thrive in collaborative settings and are eager to contribute to advanced security initiatives will find this position rewarding.

title: Cyber Security Business Analyst
description_html:
We are seeking a seasoned Cyber Security Business Analyst to enhance vulnerability management, security governance reporting, data quality, and tooling assessments within a global enterprise environment. This role involves consolidating security data, improving the accuracy of reports, coordinating ServiceNow CMDB data quality initiatives, reviewing vulnerability risk acceptances, and leading market assessments for vulnerability scanning and aggregation platforms. The ideal candidate will have strong analytical, reporting, business analysis, and stakeholder management skills, along with a solid understanding of cybersecurity risk and regulatory governance frameworks.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the preparation of weekly security posture reports, monthly Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), and governance reports for various oversight committees including the Technology Risk Committee (TRC), Information Security Committee (ISC), OpsCom, and Lloyd’s. Consolidate and reconcile data from multiple sources such as vulnerability scanning tools, security testing, cloud platforms, and ServiceNow to create a reliable and consistent security reporting framework.

Develop and maintain dashboards using Power BI or equivalent tools, including trend analysis, reporting metrics, and automated reporting processes tailored for senior stakeholders. Validate the accuracy of reports by investigating data discrepancies, documenting restatements, and tracking governance actions through to resolution.

Collaborate closely with ServiceNow CMDB and IT asset management teams to enhance asset ownership, business criticality, CIF tagging, service relationships, and overall security data quality. Reconcile asset inventories across scanning, endpoint detection, cloud, and security testing platforms to identify missing, duplicate, stale, or unscanned assets.

Lead market assessments for vulnerability scanning and aggregation platforms by gathering requirements, evaluating vendors, conducting demonstrations and proofs of concept, comparing costs, and assessing integration capabilities. Prepare comprehensive business cases, recommendation papers, and transition plans for vulnerability management tooling, considering infrastructure, cloud, containers, application security, and integration with ServiceNow/Jira.

Review vulnerability risk acceptances, exceptions, and waivers to ensure justifications, compensating controls, ownership, and expiry dates are valid. Highlight outdated or high-risk acceptances for reassessment. Conduct business analysis activities including process mapping, requirements gathering, and stakeholder workshops to identify gaps and recommend improvements in vulnerability management and security governance.

Support regulatory, audit, and compliance reporting requirements such as DORA, Lloyd’s Principle 12, remediation Metric 7, and PRA engagements. Work collaboratively with Cyber Defence, IT, Risk, Compliance, Procurement teams, and security tooling vendors to enhance reporting, operational efficiency, and governance processes.

Required Qualifications

Proven experience in business analysis within cybersecurity, IT risk, information security, or a related enterprise environment. Strong data analysis and reporting skills, including advanced proficiency in Excel and Power BI or equivalent dashboarding tools. Working knowledge of ServiceNow CMDB, IT asset management, configuration data, and understanding the impact of data quality on security operations.

Familiarity with vulnerability management concepts, risk-based prioritization, and security scoring methodologies such as CVSS, EPSS, and CISA KEV. Experience conducting technology market assessments, vendor evaluations, requirements gathering, weighted scoring, business case development, and facilitating stakeholder workshops.

Knowledge of risk acceptance, exception management, and governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) processes. Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical security risks and data insights into clear, business-focused reports suitable for committee-level audiences.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits

Experience in financial services or insurance sectors is advantageous. Familiarity with vulnerability management tools such as Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7, Vulcan, or Microsoft Defender for Cloud is preferred. Exposure to regulatory reporting frameworks including DORA, Lloyd’s, and PRA is beneficial.

Experience with CMDB improvement initiatives and reporting automation using Power Query or Python is a plus. Relevant certifications such as CBAP, BCS Business Analysis, ITIL, Security+, or CRISC are highly desirable.

This position offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of cybersecurity and business analysis, driving improvements in security posture and governance across a complex, global organization.

title: Chief Security Officer
description_html:
An established client in the aviation sector is seeking an experienced professional to assume the role of Chief Security Officer (CSO). This executive position is responsible for overseeing the protection of customers, employees, aircraft, facilities, and assets against unlawful acts, security threats, and operational risks. The CSO will develop, implement, and maintain the company’s security program in strict compliance with the Civil Aviation Security Program (NCASP), Pakistan Civil Aviation Authority (PCAA) regulations, ICAO standards, and internal governance policies.

Key Responsibilities

Security Program Governance: Maintain, execute, and continuously update the Aircraft Operator Security Program Manual (AOSP) and overall security program to ensure full compliance with PCAA, NCASP, and ICAO regulations.

Threat Assessment & Risk Management: Conduct comprehensive threat evaluations, risk analyses, and intelligence monitoring by collaborating with the Aviation Division and local agencies. Implement special anti-sabotage measures and heightened threat protocols as necessary.

External & Regulatory Liaison: Establish and maintain close operational relationships with regulatory and security bodies including PCAA AVSEC, Airports Security Force (ASF), FIA, Customs, Anti-Narcotics Force (ANF), Intelligence Bureau (IB), local police, and international station authorities.

Aircraft & Operational Protection: Support ASF efforts in securing aircraft and facilities, assist law enforcement with VVIP flight security, and coordinate anti-hijacking, anti-sabotage, and anti-smuggling initiatives.

Personnel Clearance & Vetting: Oversee the security vetting and background clearance process for company personnel through the Intelligence Bureau, Special Branch, and other relevant state security agencies.

Departmental & Staff Governance: Plan, deploy, and train security personnel, establish a clear chain of command, manage security budgets across multiple stations, and enforce a strict zero-tolerance policy toward corruption and indiscipline.

Audit, Vigilance & Quality Assurance: Lead internal and external security audits, supervise investigation and vigilance units, manage security steering committees, and ensure timely resolution of any security findings or risks.

Required Qualifications

Background: Retired senior military officer, Airports Security Force (ASF) veteran, or civil security professional with extensive leadership experience in aviation or corporate security environments.

Experience: A minimum of 10 to 15 years in security management, demonstrating proven expertise in aviation security, threat assessment, and risk management.

Regulatory Mastery: In-depth knowledge of NCASP, PCAA AVSEC regulations, ICAO Annex 17 standards, and protocols of state security agencies.

Core Competencies: Strong executive leadership capabilities, proficiency in threat intelligence analysis, crisis management skills, and effective inter-agency coordination.

This role offers a critical leadership opportunity to shape and safeguard aviation security operations at a senior level. Candidates with a strong background in aviation security and regulatory compliance will find this position both challenging and rewarding.

Pakistan International Airlines (PIA) is seeking a seasoned cybersecurity professional to join as General Manager Cybersecurity & Technology Risk (CISO) based in Islamabad. Reporting directly to the Chief Information Officer (CIO), this leadership role is pivotal in protecting the airline’s digital infrastructure, critical systems, and sensitive data. The successful candidate will be responsible for shaping and executing the enterprise-wide cybersecurity strategy, managing technology risks, ensuring governance and regulatory compliance, and enhancing the overall security posture and resilience of the airline’s operations.

Key Responsibilities
- Lead the development and implementation of the enterprise cybersecurity strategy, security architecture, and cybersecurity roadmap.
- Oversee security operations including threat monitoring, incident response, and vulnerability management in collaboration with managed security service providers.

- Manage identity and access management frameworks, privileged access controls, and technology disaster recovery plans.
- Evaluate vendor and delivery-partner security postures and lead the airline’s security certification initiatives.
- Provide independent assurance over technology delivery and platform teams, ensuring objective oversight of enterprise security and risk management.

Required Qualifications
- Minimum of 15 years’ experience in cybersecurity and technology risk, including senior leadership roles within large enterprises.
- A degree in a relevant discipline.
- Recognized cybersecurity leadership certification such as CISSP, CISM, or an equivalent professional credential.
- Proven experience in regulated or safety-critical industries; aviation or critical infrastructure sector experience is highly preferred.
- Demonstrated ability to direct managed security services and lead large-scale cybersecurity incident response efforts.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits
- Additional qualifications in risk management or governance are advantageous.
- The position offers competitive remuneration, including a company car with maintenance and fuel, as well as air tickets in accordance with company policy.

Submission of an application does not guarantee shortlisting or appointment. Interested candidates who meet the above criteria are encouraged to apply through the official application link before the closing date of 31st October 2026.

title: Cybersecurity Engineer IT
description_html:
INTECH Automation Intelligence is seeking a skilled Cybersecurity Consultant with expertise in Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC), Vulnerability Management, and Incident Management to join our IT Cybersecurity Product Team. This role is essential in delivering and implementing cybersecurity solutions that protect critical industrial infrastructure across sectors such as Oil & Gas, Petrochemicals, Utilities, and Manufacturing. The successful candidate will collaborate closely with portfolio managers, product managers, developers, and security engineers to embed security throughout the project lifecycle, from design and development to testing and deployment. Additionally, the consultant will provide GRC application consulting, streamline compliance workflows, and enhance the overall security posture of our products.

Key Responsibilities
- Design, implement, and maintain security risk management frameworks aligned with ISO 27001, NIST, ISA 62443, and other industry standards.
- Lead automation initiatives to streamline security risk, audit, and compliance processes within the product lifecycle.
- Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure product security controls meet industry and regulatory requirements.
- Develop policies, procedures, and documentation to support compliance with global security standards.
- Conduct security assessments and develop roadmaps for both client and product-focused work.
- Provide security guidance throughout the product lifecycle, from requirements gathering to deployment.
- Work with development teams to enforce secure software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices.
- Manage automated vulnerability scanning and manual penetration testing for applications and infrastructure.
- Define risk-based security testing strategies to identify vulnerabilities prior to release.
- Lead incident response planning and threat modeling exercises for new and existing products.
- Implement and manage GRC platforms such as Archer, OneTrust, LogicGate, and ServiceNow GRC to track risks, compliance gaps, and audit workflows.
- Configure security testing tools including Nessus, Qualys, Burp Suite, and OWASP ZAP.
- Develop custom security dashboards and reporting tools to provide real-time visibility into vulnerabilities and compliance status.
- Automate compliance and risk reporting to support audits, certifications, and regulatory assessments.
- Integrate security requirements into product roadmaps in collaboration with product managers.
- Deliver security awareness training for developers and DevOps teams.
- Define secure coding practices and conduct code reviews to identify security flaws.
- Perform security architecture reviews for new product features and integrations.
- Support teams in responding to security incidents, customer security assessments, and compliance requests.

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field.
- 1 to 4 years of professional experience in cybersecurity roles.
- Strong knowledge of security frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIST, and CIS.
- Proficiency with tools like Nessus, Burp Suite, Metasploit, Wireshark, Splunk, or QRadar.
- Experience with SIEM, IDS/IPS, endpoint security, and firewalls.
- Solid understanding of networking protocols, operating systems (Linux, Windows), and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
- Strong knowledge of GRC frameworks including ISO 27001, NIST 800-53, NIST CSF, SOC 2, and ISA 62443.
- Experience implementing and managing GRC platforms such as Archer, OneTrust, ServiceNow GRC, or LogicGate.
- Expertise in vulnerability management tools like Tenable Nessus, Qualys, Rapid7, or OpenVAS.
- Familiarity with application security testing methodologies (SAST, DAST, SCA).
- Hands-on experience with security automation.
- Excellent documentation and policy-writing skills.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
- Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits
Certifications such as CEH, OSCP, CISSP, CISM, CISA, or CompTIA Security+ are advantageous. INTECH offers global exposure through international projects and collaboration with global teams. We provide a competitive compensation package with performance-driven annual bonuses. Employees benefit from in-house lunch services, comprehensive health insurance covering OPD for employees and their parents, and IPD coverage for dependents. We support continuous learning through training programs, workshops, and certifications. Work-life balance is encouraged with paid time off, including annual leave and holidays. Our inclusive workplace celebrates diversity and fosters collaboration.

Joining INTECH means becoming part of a globally recognized industrial automation and digitalization technology leader with nearly 30 years of experience partnering with major oil and gas companies. You will engage in transformative Industry 4.0 projects that address real-world challenges while advancing your career in a supportive and innovative environment. INTECH Automation Intelligence is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to diversity and inclusion.

description_html:
Aptech Learning - North Karachi is seeking a dedicated Faculty Member to join their team at the center located near Power House Chorangi. The position requires working hours strictly from 1 PM to 9 PM. This role involves delivering quality education to students in various computer science and IT-related subjects. Candidates who are enthusiastic about teaching and possess a strong foundation in programming and related technologies are encouraged to apply. While prior teaching experience is not mandatory, the ability to effectively communicate and engage with students is essential. Part-time applicants are discouraged, but students awaiting their final results are welcome to apply.

Key Responsibilities:
- Deliver instructional sessions on computer programming, object-oriented programming (OOP), web designing, and database management.
- Utilize modern development tools and frameworks to enhance the learning experience.
- Prepare course materials and assist students in understanding complex technical concepts.
- Foster a positive and interactive classroom environment that encourages student participation and learning.
- Continuously update knowledge of emerging technologies to keep course content relevant.

Required Qualifications:
- A degree in BE, BS, MS, or equivalent in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Cyber Security, Computer Network & Security, Machine Learning, or a closely related field.
- Strong knowledge of computer programming fundamentals, including OOP, web design, and databases.
- Familiarity with contemporary development tools and frameworks.
- Ability and willingness to teach students effectively, regardless of prior teaching experience.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits:
- IT certifications are considered an advantage and will strengthen the candidate’s profile.
- This is a full-time position offering a monthly salary ranging from Rs40,000 to Rs60,000.
- Career growth and promotional opportunities within the organization.
- Annual paid leaves along with other leave benefits.
- A positive, supportive, and hygienic working environment that values employee well-being.
- Annual salary increments based on performance.
- Engagement in employee activities such as award ceremonies, dinners, and picnics to recognize and celebrate achievements.

The role requires the candidate to work on-site at the North Karachi center, ensuring direct interaction with students and team members. This opportunity is ideal for fresh graduates or those new to teaching who are eager to build a career in education and technology.

title: Cybersecurity Engineer
description_html:
We are seeking a highly skilled and versatile Security Engineer to lead and deliver across a broad range of cybersecurity engagements. This role primarily focuses on offensive security, including network and application penetration testing, web and PHP application exploitation, and adversarial testing of AI and large language models (LLM). Beyond offensive tasks, you will also establish and manage defensive controls, develop security policies, and ensure compliance with audits. Operating within Plutus21 and its client environments, you will balance hands-on technical work with governance, tooling development, and team-building as the security function expands.

Key Responsibilities

- Conduct comprehensive penetration tests on networks, applications, APIs, and cloud environments using recognized methodologies such as PTES, covering all phases from scoping to retesting.
- Execute red-team and adversary simulation exercises aligned with the MITRE ATT&CK framework, delivering realistic attack scenarios rather than isolated vulnerability reports.
- Perform social engineering and phishing assessments when authorized.
- Provide detailed findings with proof-of-concept exploits, business impact analysis, severity ratings (CVSS), and actionable remediation guidance.
- Exploit and report on the full OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, with deep expertise in PHP application testing (Laravel, WordPress, and legacy custom stacks), including source-assisted review and complex exploitation techniques.
- Test REST and GraphQL APIs and single-page applications against current attack vectors.
- Red-team AI and LLM systems focusing on prompt injection, jailbreaks, data exfiltration, insecure tool use, and denial-of-service risks, translating findings into engineering guardrails and test cases.
- Integrate secure development practices into CI/CD pipelines, including threat modeling, secure code review, and security testing (SAST, DAST, dependency and secret scanning).
- Design, implement, and maintain security controls across cloud platforms (preferably AWS), corporate infrastructure, endpoints, and identity management systems, enforcing least-privilege access with MFA and regular reviews.
- Lead security operations including threat monitoring, alert triage, incident response, and post-incident analysis, while managing SIEM, EDR, vulnerability scanning, and cloud security posture management tools.
- Develop and maintain security policies, standards, and procedures aligned with recognized frameworks.
- Drive compliance and audit readiness for SOC 2, ISO 27001, and NIST CSF, including evidence collection and control mapping.
- Assess vendor and client security postures, providing clear, prioritized remediation recommendations.
- Communicate risks, incidents, and security metrics effectively to leadership and non-technical stakeholders.
- Deliver security awareness training for internal teams.
- Define the security team’s structure, roadmap, and hiring plan as the function grows.
- Within the first 90 days, conduct an internal penetration test of Plutus21’s cloud and applications, establish core security tooling, complete an external client engagement, and publish initial security policies and SOC 2 control mappings.

Required Qualifications

- Minimum five years of hands-on cybersecurity experience with a strong focus on offensive security, including penetration testing or red teaming as a primary responsibility.
- Proven expertise in web application testing, particularly with PHP-heavy environments such as Laravel, WordPress, or legacy custom codebases.
- Deep understanding of the OWASP Top 10 and modern web and API attack techniques, with demonstrated ability to produce working exploits.
- Familiarity with AI and LLM attack surfaces, including prompt injection and jailbreaks, or the aptitude to quickly acquire this knowledge.
- Solid experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS preferred) and its native security services.
- Practical skills in incident response, threat detection, and log analysis using SIEM and EDR tools.
- Strong foundational knowledge of networking, operating systems, identity management, and encryption.
- Proficiency in scripting and automation using Python, Bash, or PowerShell.
- Experience with compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or NIST CSF.
- Self-motivated and capable of independently managing a security function from inception, with strong prioritization skills under pressure.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, able to translate complex technical risks into clear, accessible language for diverse audiences.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits

- Offensive security certifications such as OSCP (highly preferred), OSWE, OSEP, or CRTP.
- Broader security credentials including CISSP, CEH, CompTIA Security+, or recognized cloud security certifications.
- A public record of security contributions, such as bug bounty achievements, CVEs, published research, or a portfolio of tools and write-ups.
- Proficiency with Burp Suite Professional, including custom tooling or extension development.
- Hands-on experience with AI red-teaming against production LLM or agent systems.
- Exposure to multiple cloud environments and experience working in consulting or multi-client delivery settings.

This role offers the unique opportunity to shape and lead a comprehensive security program, combining offensive expertise with strategic governance and client-facing responsibilities.

title: Journalist
description_html:
Better It for Less is seeking a skilled Tech Journalist & Content Writer to join their remote content and marketing team. This full-time role requires a mid-level professional with 3 to 5+ years of experience in journalism, content writing, or copywriting, preferably with a focus on technology. The successful candidate will monitor and report on the latest trends in IT, managed services (MSPs), AI, cybersecurity, cloud computing, and related fields. They will transform complex technical information into clear, engaging content across various formats, supporting marketing efforts and thought leadership initiatives. The position follows a Monday to Friday schedule, from 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM US Central Time.

Key Responsibilities

- Monitor news, trends, and product releases across IT, cybersecurity, cloud, MSPs, AI, and the broader technology sector.
- Write timely news articles, analysis pieces, and opinion content for the company’s website and publications.
- Produce diverse content including blog posts, whitepapers, case studies, newsletters, and thought-leadership materials.
- Develop persuasive marketing copy for web pages, email campaigns, social media platforms, and advertisements.
- Research, outline, and write long-form content such as ebooks and books on technology topics.
- Conduct interviews with industry experts, partners, and clients; cover events and product launches.
- Fact-check all content rigorously and cite sources accurately to maintain credibility.
- Edit and proofread both personal and team members’ work to ensure accuracy, appropriate tone, and consistent style.
- Optimize content for SEO and maximize audience engagement.
- Collaborate with training, marketing, and technical teams to simplify complex topics for diverse audiences.
- Ghostwrite non-fiction book content as needed.

Required Qualifications

- Minimum of 3 years’ experience in journalism, content writing, or copywriting, ideally with a focus on technology.
- Strong understanding of IT, MSPs, cloud computing, cybersecurity, and AI, coupled with a genuine passion for staying current in these areas.
- Exceptional writing, editing, and storytelling skills, capable of producing both concise copy and detailed long-form content.
- Proven experience contributing to or authoring books, ebooks, or other extended publications is highly preferred.
- Excellent research and fact-checking abilities, with the capacity to meet tight deadlines consistently.
- Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Familiarity with SEO best practices, content management systems, and social media platforms.
- A portfolio showcasing published work is required for consideration.

Preferred Qualifications

- Degree in journalism, communications, English, or a related field.
- Experience responsibly utilizing AI tools to enhance research and content creation workflows.
- Basic knowledge of design or publishing software is an advantage.

This role offers the opportunity to work remotely within a dynamic team focused on delivering high-quality, insightful technology content. The position reports to the content and marketing department and operates on a standard Monday through Friday schedule aligned with US Central Time. Candidates passionate about technology and skilled in crafting compelling narratives are encouraged to apply.

title: Online Reputation & Reviews Specialist
description_html:
People Perfect is seeking an Online Reputation & Reviews Specialist for a client in the training industry. This remote role focuses on enhancing the client’s online presence across multiple brands and review platforms by managing genuine customer review invitations, maintaining authorised business profiles, and ensuring that authentic customer experiences are accurately represented online in compliance with platform policies. The position is detail-oriented and sits within the Marketing & Customer Experience department, requiring close collaboration with management and other business teams.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Review Management: Identify genuine customers who have recently used the client’s services and invite them to provide honest reviews. Monitor feedback on platforms such as Google and Trustpilot, maintain accurate records of invitations and responses, and ensure the integrity of the review process.

Online Account Management: Create and maintain authorised company email accounts and business profiles. Ensure that account information is accurate and consistent across platforms, while securely managing access permissions and records.

Cloud & Technical Support: Confidently work with AWS EC2 and remote cloud environments, adhering to cybersecurity and access-control protocols. Support authorised UK-hosted systems to facilitate legitimate business operations.

Quality Assurance & Compliance: Verify the accuracy of all communications and confirm that feedback corresponds to genuine customer experiences. Identify and flag duplicate or suspicious reviews and maintain audit-ready documentation that complies with platform standards.

Reporting & Performance: Generate weekly reports detailing review invitations, verified reviews, and feedback trends. Track activity across each brand, escalate negative feedback to management promptly, and recommend strategies to enhance customer satisfaction.

Required Qualifications

- 2-3 years of relevant experience in online reputation management or related fields.
- Excellent written English with strong attention to detail.
- Proven experience managing online accounts, email systems, and review management platforms such as Google Business Profile and Trustpilot.
- Proficiency with Google Workspace or Microsoft 365; familiarity with Monday.com or CRM systems is advantageous.
- Working knowledge of AWS EC2 and cloud-based systems, including an understanding of data protection and account security.
- Strong administrative and organisational skills, capable of handling repetitive tasks with accuracy.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits

Experience in managing customer feedback campaigns or online reputation initiatives is highly desirable. The role offers the flexibility of remote work, operating within UK business hours from Monday to Friday. This position provides an opportunity to work closely with cross-functional teams and contribute directly to improving the client’s customer experience and brand reputation.

This role is ideal for detail-oriented professionals who thrive in a structured, remote environment and are passionate about maintaining authentic online reputations.

description_html:
Superior University Official is dedicated to empowering learners and nurturing their potential, grounded in the belief that every individual can achieve ambitious goals. The institution promotes a culture that supports dreamers, innovators, and problem-solvers through inclusive academic programs and student-centered initiatives. Faculty and staff are encouraged to inspire students to realize their aspirations and become leaders in their fields. The role involves preparing and delivering lectures, supervising labs and projects, assessing student performance, and maintaining high standards of teaching and learning. title: Instructional Designer – Domain Specialist
description_html:
Talent Pool 360 is seeking a dedicated Instructional Designer Domain Specialist who combines solid instructional design skills with deep, hands-on experience in a specific professional domain. This role requires an individual with 2 years of practical expertise in domains such as Sales, Marketing, Cybersecurity, Finance, or Administration & Operations. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing performance-focused learning solutions including training modules, simulations, scenarios, and assessments that reflect real business processes and challenges. This position includes leading a team of 20 professionals, ensuring collaboration and quality delivery of learning initiatives aimed at enhancing organizational knowledge and performance. This role is uniquely tailored for those who have demonstrated their ability to apply their domain knowledge through practical projects, effective use of relevant tools, and real-world problem-solving. Candidates should be able to translate complex domain expertise into structured and effective learning experiences that drive business results. Instructional design duties include conducting needs analysis, working closely with subject matter experts, creating learner and facilitator materials, and continuously updating and evaluating content. Practical experience with domain-specific tools and proven instructional design capabilities are critical for success in this role.
Responsibilities
  • Lead and manage a team of 20 instructional designers and learning specialists to deliver high-quality training content anchored in practical domain knowledge.
  • Conduct training needs analysis and identify knowledge and performance gaps within assigned domains.
  • Collaborate with subject matter experts to gather accurate and relevant domain knowledge for instructional content development.
  • Design and develop structured courses, learning paths, e-learning modules, and self-paced training materials that translate real-world business processes into effective learning experiences.
  • Create practical simulations, scenarios, case studies, assessments, and job aids that foster skills application in authentic operational contexts.
  • Convert standard operating procedures, technical documentation, and complex workflows into accessible and engaging training modules.
  • Utilize AI and digital authoring tools to enhance instructional design processes and improve learner engagement and retention.
  • Evaluate learning effectiveness through metrics and feedback, making data-driven updates to content to ensure alignment with changing business needs and processes.
  • Demonstrate and apply project management skills in planning, executing, and delivering instructional design projects on time and within scope.
  • Develop comprehensive facilitator and learner guides that support diverse learning styles and enhance instructional delivery.
  • Maintain strong communication across cross-functional teams to facilitate smooth workflow and knowledge sharing.
  • Support learners and stakeholders by addressing training-related inquiries and providing ongoing learning support.
  • Stay current with emerging instructional design methodologies and domain-specific trends to maintain the relevance and effectiveness of training content.
  • Document and share best practices, lessons learned, and instructional innovations with the wider Learning & Development community within the organization.

title: Pre Sales Engineer - Cybersecurity & ICT Solutions
description_html:
We are looking for a motivated Presales Engineer to join our team and support our Cybersecurity and ICT solution portfolio. In this role, you will collaborate closely with clients and internal teams to understand their needs, design customized technical solutions, and effectively position our offerings throughout the sales process. Your expertise will help bridge the gap between technical requirements and business objectives, ensuring successful engagements from initial contact through to solution delivery.

Key Responsibilities:
- Work alongside sales teams to analyze customer requirements and translate them into clear, well-structured technical solutions.
- Prepare and deliver technical presentations, demonstrations, and workshops that highlight our Cybersecurity and ICT capabilities.
- Design solution architectures, Bills of Quantities (BoQs), and proposals covering networking, infrastructure, and security systems.
- Participate in responding to Requests for Proposals (RFPs) and Requests for Quotations (RFQs), ensuring technical alignment with customer needs and compliance standards.
- Conduct proof-of-concepts (POCs) and assist clients during evaluation and validation phases.
- Provide technical guidance, sizing, and design support throughout the presales cycle to support sales efforts.
- Coordinate with post-sales and delivery teams to ensure smooth handover of solution designs and documentation.
- Stay informed about emerging trends and technologies in Cybersecurity, Cloud, and ICT infrastructure to continuously improve solution offerings.

Required Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
- 2 to 3 years of experience in presales, solution design, or technical consultancy within Cybersecurity and ICT domains.
- Solid understanding of network infrastructure, system integration, and security technologies such as Firewalls, Web Application Firewalls (WAF), Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Privileged Access Management (PAM), Identity and Access Management (IAM), Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response (SOAR), servers, storage, virtualization, cloud, and data center solutions.
- Strong technical writing and proposal development skills, with the ability to communicate effectively to both technical and business audiences.
- Excellent presentation, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits:
- Relevant industry certifications in Cybersecurity or ICT are considered an advantage.
- Competitive monthly salary ranging from Rs50,000 to Rs150,000 based on experience and qualifications.
- Work location requires in-person attendance, fostering close collaboration with teams and clients.

Application Questions:
- What are your salary expectations?
- What is your notice period?

This position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge Cybersecurity and ICT solutions while working in a dynamic and supportive environment. If you have a passion for technology and a strong customer-focused approach, we encourage you to apply.

- Excellent customer relationship management abilities.
- Ability to work independently and achieve sales targets.

- Professional and supportive work environment fostering growth.

- Exposure to IT, networking, cybersecurity, and technology solutions.

title: Senior Manager Enterprise Sales
description_html:
PTCL is seeking a dynamic leader to head a team of Key Account Managers focused on driving sales and business development across Connectivity, Telecom, Digital, ICT, and Mobility sectors. This role involves identifying new business opportunities, nurturing existing client relationships, and delivering strategic solutions aligned with customer needs and business goals. The successful candidate will oversee contract management, revenue forecasting, churn control, and profitability analysis while providing actionable insights to senior management. Staying abreast of market trends and fostering a high-performing team culture are essential to support PTCL’s growth and innovation agenda.

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and manage a team of Key Account Managers to achieve sales targets and expand business across multiple technology domains.
- Identify emerging market opportunities, analyze industry trends, and develop strategies to enhance PTCL’s market presence.
- Assess customer requirements and challenges to design customized solutions that drive long-term business growth.
- Develop and implement go-to-market strategies, leveraging cross-selling and upselling to maximize account value and revenue.
- Translate business objectives into actionable sales plans and maintain strong client relationships through regular engagement.
- Oversee contract lifecycle management, including timely renewals and revisions, while preparing accurate revenue forecasts and performance reports.
- Monitor sales performance, conduct profitability analysis, and collaborate with Finance and other stakeholders to meet territory targets.
- Coordinate cross-functionally with Customer Success, Service Delivery, Product, Technical Support, Finance, and Operations teams to resolve issues and ensure seamless service delivery.
- Champion a customer-centric approach by maintaining high service quality, addressing concerns proactively, and improving customer satisfaction and Net Promoter Score (NPS).

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree from a reputable institution is mandatory; an MBA is considered an advantage.
- 10 to 15 years of relevant experience in Telecom or ICT sales.
- Proven experience in Sales, Business Development, or Key Account Management within the IT industry or IT service providers.
- Demonstrated success in meeting and exceeding sales targets.
- Prior experience managing teams effectively.
- Strong track record of delivering customer-centric solutions that meet or exceed expectations.
- Familiarity with advanced sales methodologies such as The Challenger Sales, MEDDIC, or MEDDPICC.
- Exceptional planning, organizational, negotiation, and communication skills.
- Ability to perform well under pressure and tight deadlines.
- Self-motivated, innovative thinker with strong problem-solving capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits

PTCL fosters an inclusive and diverse work environment that values every individual regardless of gender, social background, religion, belief, or disability. The company is committed to culture transformation and change management, aiming to be the leading driver of Pakistan’s digital transformation.

Employees benefit from family-centric policies, including six months of maternity leave and 30 days of paternity leave, supporting a balanced and fulfilling career. Additionally, PTCL offers a hybrid work model to promote flexibility and work-life harmony.

Joining PTCL means becoming part of a visionary organization dedicated to innovation, resilience, and success, with core values that inspire employees to think big, win every battle, and value achievement.

title: Assistant Manager IT Department
description_html:
The Assistant IT Manager – SAP BI will play a crucial role in managing and supporting the organization’s SAP Business Intelligence systems. This position involves developing and maintaining BI reports, dashboards, and data analysis tools to aid management in decision-making. The role requires close collaboration with various departments such as Finance, Sales, Purchase, Inventory, Warehouse, and Operations to ensure reporting requirements are accurately understood and met. The candidate will also troubleshoot SAP BI issues, support system upgrades and implementations, and work on process improvements to enhance reporting efficiency. Additionally, the role includes supervising IT support activities, maintaining data security and user access controls, and providing training and technical support to users.

Key Responsibilities

- Manage and support SAP BI systems, including reports, dashboards, and data analysis.
- Develop and maintain BI reports to facilitate informed management decisions.
- Monitor data accuracy, consistency, and integration across SAP modules and other business systems.
- Analyze business data and prepare periodic performance reports for management review.
- Collaborate with Finance, Sales, Purchase, Inventory, Warehouse, and Operations teams to gather and understand reporting needs.
- Troubleshoot SAP BI issues and coordinate with technical teams to ensure timely resolution.
- Support SAP implementations, system upgrades, testing, and continuous process improvements.
- Assist in automating reports and enhancing reporting efficiency.
- Maintain data security protocols, user access controls, and comprehensive system documentation.
- Supervise IT support activities and assist the IT Manager with daily operational tasks.
- Train end-users on SAP BI reports and provide ongoing technical support as needed.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.
- 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in SAP BI, Business Intelligence, or data analytics.
- Proficient in SAP BI/BW, SAP HANA, Power BI, SQL, and dashboard development.
- Strong skills in data analysis, report automation, KPI tracking, and data visualization.
- Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel and experience with database management and reporting tools.
- Demonstrated ability in team coordination, problem-solving, project support, and prioritizing tasks.
- Excellent communication skills with the ability to liaise effectively between technical and non-technical stakeholders and explain complex reports clearly.

Compensation and Work Location

The position offers a monthly salary range of Rs. 100,000 to Rs. 150,000. This is an in-person role, requiring the candidate to work onsite.

This role is ideal for a motivated IT professional seeking to leverage their SAP BI expertise in a dynamic environment, contributing to data-driven decision-making and operational excellence.
